papers.title: An integrated bioprocess for xylanase production from agriculture waste under open non-sterilized conditions: Biofabrication as fermentation tool
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Biotechnology, Donghua University, Shanghai 201620, China

corresponding_authors.name: Altaf Ahmed Simair
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Biotechnology, Donghua University, Shanghai 201620, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及利用生物制造作为发酵工具生产木聚糖酶，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on enzyme production via biofabrication fermentation, with no AI integration, bioprinting workflow, or experimental validation relevant to bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用农业废弃物生产木聚糖酶，降低生产成本。
summary_zh.method: 采用开放式非无菌条件，以生物制造作为发酵工具。
summary_zh.result: 成功实现木聚糖酶的高效生产。
summary_zh.validation: 通过酶活性测定验证生产效果。

summary_en.motivation: To produce xylanase from agricultural waste under cost-effective, non-sterilized conditions using biofabrication as a fermentation tool.
summary_en.method: An integrated bioprocess was developed using open non-sterilized fermentation with biofabrication.
summary_en.result: High xylanase production yields were achieved under the proposed conditions.
summary_en.validation: Enzyme activity assays confirmed the efficiency of the bioprocess.
